summary: EmitImplicitWithFlattening built SynthesizedTarget against the unexpanded With target, so `With .Foo ... .Bar` produced a synthesized node still containing an implicit-with leaf.
fix: Added ExpandFlattenedTarget; substitutes the recorded ResolvedViaWithFlattening.SynthesizedTarget for the With target before synthesising the new MemberAccess/BangAccess. Added regression test NestedWith_TargetIsImplicitWithMember_FullyExpandsSynthesizedTarget.

summary: Fixture_RunsToCompletionWithKnownReasonCodes accepted ResolvedViaWithFlattening but did not recurse into InnerOutcome, so an unrecognised Unresolved reason inside a flattening would not be caught.
fix: Refactored the variant check into AssertOutcomeRecognised which recurses through ResolvedViaWithFlattening.InnerOutcome.
